verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and self-contained. It establishes a bijection between the left cosets of each centralizer and the corresponding conjugacy class, deduces that every noncentral conjugacy class has size divisible by p, and applies the class equation to conclude that p divides |Z(G)|. Since the identity lies in Z(G) and a positive multiple of p is at least p >= 2, the center contains a nonidentity element. All hypotheses are used, no logical gaps or hard-prohibition violations occur, and no external or fact-graph references require checking.
